q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of colour coated roofing sheet per tonne?
title: Colour coated sheet carbon footprint per tonne
short: Start with the galvanised or galvalume steel coil per tonne and multiply by the supplier's figure. Add paint, pretreatment and the coating line's curing oven fuel and electricity, plus roll forming, then divide by tonnes dispatched.
audience: Colour coating lines and roofing sheet sellers

ul: Galvanised or galvalume base coil by weight.
Curing ovens, usually fired by gas or oil.

p: Report per tonne, and per sheet on request using its length, thickness and profile. The base steel coil usually carries most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: colour coated sheet unit per tonne (one month)
lines: Plant total: 124,600 / 2,000 = 62.3 kg CO2 per tonne
Add base coil and paint for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
